answer_1.quote: We prompt LMs to generate an original story given the beginning of a story from one of the events in the list...
answer_1.outputs: generated stories, question‑answer pairs for fact recall, fluency scores

answer_2.quote: We compute the ROUGE-L score between the generated output and the next 50 words of the source text... Fact recall is evaluated by computing the F1 score... Fluency is evaluated using the Prometheus‑v2 model...

answer_3.quote: We utilize Flan‑T5‑XL as the attribution model to assess the inclusion of each reference event in the generated story... We use Prometheus‑v2 as the evaluator to assess the fluency of the LM generation...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human annotation on a subset of test cases. We provide the annotators with the generated story along with a list of events and characters, asking them to identify which of these are present in the story...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators identify which events and characters are present in the generated story, treating each as a binary classification problem.
